reason: Calculates and displays cumulative conversation costs from token usage using configurable per-model and peak/off-peak pricing, with locally persisted settings and session ledger entries.

summaries.zh: 根据会话 token 用量和可配置的模型及峰谷价格，计算并显示累计对话花费。
summaries.en: Calculates and displays cumulative conversation costs from token usage using configurable model and peak/off-peak pricing.

capabilities: Reads session token-usage data to calculate per-round and cumulative costs
Stores configurable model pricing and session cost ledger entries locally
Adds a cumulative cost display and pricing configuration interface
Provides same-origin routes for reading and updating plugin configuration and session ledger summaries
